scripts.dev: npm run dev:runtime & npm run dev:portal
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:portal
scripts.lint: oxlint contracts shared agent-engine orchestrator runtime-host scripts eval tests --ignore-pattern 'portal/**'
scripts.validate:deploy: helm lint deploy/runtime/helm && helm template sre-agent-manager deploy/runtime/helm -f deploy/runtime/helm/values/manager.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-active-directory deploy/runtime/helm -f deploy/runtime/helm/values/active-directory.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-openshift deploy/runtime/helm -f deploy/runtime/helm/values/openshift.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-network-observability deploy/runtime/helm -f deploy/runtime/helm/values/network-observability.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-keycloak deploy/runtime/helm -f deploy/runtime/helm/values/keycloak.yaml > /dev/null && helm template sre-agent-observability deploy/runtime/helm -f deploy/runtime/helm/values/observability.yaml > /dev/null && helm lint deploy/portal/helm && helm template sre-agent-portal deploy/portal/helm > /dev/null
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate:boundaries && npm run test && npm run validate:yaml && npm run validate:deploy
